methodology.benchmark: CSI 300 uses the same open entry, exit mode, rotating sleeves and transaction cost
methodology.cash: fewer than five picks, verified pauses, limit-up opens and target-day risk-status changes leave slots in cash; missing quotes are data errors
methodology.corporate_actions: entry and exit prices use the same point-in-time adjustment-factor basis; this is a gross-adjusted proxy, not a tax-lot dividend cash ledger
methodology.cost: 100-share board lots with per-order minimum commission, date-effective sell stamp tax, transfer fee and slippage
methodology.deferred_exit: if the scheduled exit cannot trade, sell at the first later executable session using the selected open/close
methodology.determinism: score descending then code ascending; candidate and Top5 hashes are frozen per model and target day
methodology.exit: D+1/D+3/D+5 official open and official close
methodology.monthly_return: realized per-stock ledger; D+N uses (N+1)*5 rank slots, keeps delayed holdings locked, and attributes profit to the actual settlement month
methodology.price_limits: official daily limits first, otherwise date-effective main-board rules with half-up tick rounding; risk-warning limits switch from 5% to 10% on 2026-07-06
methodology.risk_labels: signal-day is_st is authoritative; end-of-range display names are not used for historical risk filtering
methodology.tail_risk: quality/doubao reject signal-day 14:44-to-15:00 price gains above 3%
methodology.top5_daily_return: sum of individual net returns divided by five; raw stock return sum is retained for audit only

warnings: 仅为第一层技术策略年度重放，不是完整三层回测
历史热榜、事件快照和财报预约变更记录不可验证，未生成三层确认收益
热榜策略在技术层使用可复算多头代理，不代表历史热榜原名单
行业使用逐季度申万一级历史成分快照
月度收益按实际卖出月确认，不是每日Top5收益的简单相加
缺少逐笔权益分派与持有期税率，收益标记为gross-adjusted proxy，不能标注为完全真实税后收益
回测结束仍未卖出的持仓单列锁定本金，不按最后价格强制结算
研究结果不会写入生产数据库或生产看板
